id_mapping.detail: ALLOC F-01..F-20, STDIO F1..F15, NUMWIDE F01..F21 and LIFE F1..F21 are source-audit IDs copied verbatim. AUDIT_memory_string.md numbers only its top 5 issues (#1..#5) and otherwise identifies findings by function; MEMSTR-01..MEMSTR-50 are sequential IDs derived in section-2 document order, with the two section-2.7 tiers appended as MEMSTR-49/50. Every MEMSTR entry is marked id_mapping='derived'. source_id is populated only where the audit's numbered top issue maps to that row: #1 -> MEMSTR-47 (isblank), #2 -> MEMSTR-08 (strncpy), #3 -> MEMSTR-15 (memrchr), #4 -> MEMSTR-26 (memcmp_bounded sentinel), #5 -> MEMSTR-24/25 (bounded source capacity).

status_definitions.FIXED: A named fix commit and an existing acceptance test were verified; no FIXED entry relies on a build or emulator result alone.
status_definitions.DOCUMENTED-CONTRACT: Inherent/documented limitation or caller responsibility; the audit itself (or a cited evidence doc) is the evidence. Not a claim of safety or of a code fix.
status_definitions.GAP-COMPILER: Resolution requires an Agent 1 compiler/toolchain change; only a hand-off/gap document exists in this branch.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Missing API with no dependency-closed pinned upstream source or toolchain support; SKIPs are retained, not fabricated implementations.
status_definitions.OPEN: Actionable runtime finding with no fix commit and no documentation-only resolution in the audited sources.

reconciliation.severity_aggregate: HIGH 16 / MEDIUM 68 / other 43, matching WRAPPER_SAFETY_AUDIT.md section 2. 'other' = LOW 38 + DOCUMENTED_LIMIT 4 + INFO 1.
discrepancies: AUDIT_memory_string.md provides no individual finding IDs: only #1..#5 in section 5. All 50 MEMSTR IDs are derived; mapping type is recorded per finding.

AUDIT_memory_string.md section 4 severity narrative (6/27/16/1) is reconciled by rolling its two ctype Low buckets into MEMSTR-46/48 and counting the two section-2.7 tiers (direct _s, timing-safe) as the remaining Medium entries; the 50 section-2 rows plus 2 tiers minus 2 rolled-up ctype rows keep the family total at 50.

AUDIT_memory_string.md section 4 lists four cross-cutting findings (a)-(d) as not attributed to a single function; they are not separately counted here and are represented under the related per-function IDs (MEMSTR-01, -08, -22, -26).
cplus_isblank (MEMSTR-47) was fixed in b7d1686/5009b6b BEFORE the 595531f audit baseline but is still reported as High by the audit; FIXED is asserted on those commits plus tests/libc/test_ctype2.c.

AUDIT_memory_string.md #1 (isblank), #2 (strncpy family) and #3 (memchr/memrchr/stpncpy) are FIXED, but the High findings for cplus_strcpy (MEMSTR-07) and cplus_strcat (MEMSTR-09) were NOT changed by 5fe387d and remain OPEN; they are not counted as collateral fixes.

WRAPPER_SAFETY_AUDIT.md section 3 items 9 (27 missing C23 APIs) and 10 (Agent 1 compiler contracts) are cross-cutting themes, not extra numbered findings; they are represented by NUMWIDE-07..10/-11/-18/-21, ALLOC-07 and STDIO-07/-08/-14. No extra IDs were invented to force the total.
NUMWIDE-16 (logger errno) and LIFE-06 share the same log.c fix in 5fe387d; both are independently listed because both source audits numbered them.
reconciliation.no_fix_claim_without_evidence: Every FIXED entry carries a fix_commits entry and an acceptance_test command. FIXED entries from 5fe387d are additionally covered by docs/libc/AUDIT_HIGH_REGRESSION.md (113/113 checks, plain and UBSan).
